spiritual_reading:
When the good that engages directly with evil was sent forth into spiritual combat, it was invested with the first and most immediate power of Divine love for salvation, and by that power it entered into the earliest formed level where life can be received, holding all action in a single invested protection. From that power it overcame the intending of spiritual death and the whole sufficient series of subordinate impulses and persuasions that proceed from it.

When that good was raised out of the lowest and most obscured level, the Divine operative that gives life and order brought up the dominant falsities and evils that had been subdued, together with the general falsified principles that belong to the domain of denial, in order to arrange them into an outward order and to form from them a structured realm of effects suited to the manifestation of Divine greatness in ultimates. From that time, the interiors where those falsified and perverted principles had been gathered and held were broken up; their former arrangement was devastated, and the whole content that had been fixed there was deprived of its prior power.

This was like the separation that occurs when a mixed and murky state is subjected to a restraining order: the living affections and the elevated thoughts that had been trapped are bound and removed, while only the undistinguished generalities remain, together with the lowest rudiments that can still serve as a basis for later ordering. So it was with the interiors devoted to spiritual death: the good that combats seized and bound their deliberations and the allied powers that were active within them, and those interiors themselves remained as mere containing forms in the same outward plane where they had been.

Accordingly, the domain of denial is in this condition, and the interiors that were within it are in this condition.

For as a person is an organized whole with many subordinate functions dependent on a ruling principle, so the domain of denial had, from its beginning, many interior compartments of perverted life and falsified thought, all dependent on a principal governing falsity. One origin served them all, because all were dependent on that ruling falsity which dominated the whole arrangement. If some particular derivative falsity or evil were removed at its outermost extension, the ruling falsity that governed them all would still remain as it was in its own place, and the total perverted system would still persist as active. All those derivative ruling points were fixed with strength within that principal governing falsity.

And when they are removed in their entirety, those derivative ruling points become void of life, because they no longer appear to possess power or stability from being fixed within the organized perversion to which they had been joined; severed from that connection, they are left without the seeming vitality they drew from it.

In the same way, the interiors of denial are such: they are the very ordered forms from which the outflow of falsity and evil originally proceeded.

fills.notes: The substrate regularly distinguishes the ‘first nature’ as the earliest formed receptive level; ‘first’ tightens the correspondential sequence: First garment → first nature → first combat.
The lacuna marks the transition from invested protection to the act of combat; a simple connective best fits the impersonal oldest layer.
What is hunted in this stratum are the archontic powers that administer the death-intent; naming them keeps the register cosmological (agents), not moral.
Temporal-step marker is required: descent and return of First Man, then the Living Spirit’s ordering work.
The phrase must coordinate two brought-up sets: rulers plus the general principle-element that follows.

Correspondentially this is the general falsified principle belonging to the ‘domain of denial’ (darkness). ‘Element’ here is not a physical element but a general principle out of which effects are formed.

fills.fill: he took out of the storehouses
fills.notes: The Living Spirit brings up what the First Man has hunted; the next clause speaks of the storehouses of the elements, so the extraction-from-storehouses is the demanded connective action.
The chapter’s controlling term for the interiors devoted to spiritual death; it must recur here where their ‘place’ is then devastated.
The text needs a plural collective allied to ‘counsels’: not ‘king’ but ‘kin’, i.e., associated powers bound to the deliberations.
The syntax requires a bridging phrase: the land has storehouses in it from its beginning, and then the comparison to limbs continues.
Needed to complete the conditional comparison: even if a limb is cut, the great head remains, and you still find the person alive.
The following clause ‘are firmly set in it’ requires an antecedent ‘it’ = the great head; correspondentially the derivatives are fixed in the ruling falsity.
Direct continuation of ¶5’s ‘small heads’; the paragraph explains what happens when they are cut off in entirety.
The comparison must make explicit the loss of life when severed: ‘dead like the corpses’ matches the spiritual explanation (void of life).

fills.fill: no power, because they no longer
fills.notes: The logic demanded: they lose apparent power once severed from what fixed them; this matches the correspondential ‘no longer appear to possess power or stability’.
Needed to link ‘be firmly set’ to its ground: being firmly set in the body to which they were joined.
Completes the preposition+pronoun sequence (‘with it’) without importing later editorial matter; keeps the clause flowing into the lost continuation.

assessment: Most gaps are short connectors or repeated cosmological terms constrained by the chapter’s governing correspondence (storehouses as interiors, heads as ruling falsities). A few larger lacunae in ¶1–2 and ¶6 admit more than one philological solution; restorations there were chosen to keep the impersonal, Iranian-cosmological register and to preserve the fixed correspondential sequence: investment → hunting/binding → extraction → ordering into universe → devastation of storehouses → persistence of the great head until all derivatives are cut.
